newsitem.title: USA: Coltec completes sale of Farnam Sealing.
newsitem.headline: Coltec completes sale of Farnam Sealing.

text.p: Coltec Industries Monday said it completed the sale of its Farnam Sealing Systems business to a subsidiary of Meillor S.A.. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Farnam, which produces engine, transmission and fuel gaskets, had sales of $47 million in 1995.

John W. Guffey, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Coltec Industries, said, "This transaction completes our exit from the production of systems and components for the automotive original equipment market. We are now focusing all of our resources in our aerospace and industrial operations, where we have strong market positions and excellent growth prospects."
Coltec Industries is a diversified manufacturing company serving primarily aerospace and industrial markets.
